section_summary.extract_value: This section discusses methodological considerations for investigating the threshold hypothesis, primarily referencing Karwowski and Gralewski (2013). It outlines three criteria for accepting or rejecting the hypothesis using a correlational approach and notes that Karwowski and Gralewski (2013) found a threshold effect most likely at an IQ of 115 under the most conservative criterion. The section also addresses the scattered findings in the literature regarding intelligence and creative potential, suggesting that different conceptions and measures of creativity (e.g., ideational fluency vs. originality) might contribute to these inconsistencies.
